purpose: Field-level compatibility of the current official PDFs (AcroForm) against the verified DOCX originals. Counts and flags only; no equivalence is claimed.
method: DOCX: buildDocxFieldInventory on the five verified DOCX originals. PDF: pdfjs getFieldObjects on the six current PDFs (unique names). Matching: lowercase, alphanumeric-only, trailing 'RowN' removed.
finding: Name identity is not usable as a key. DOCX names are generic (e.g. Text1, Check46, CourtFileNo) and repeat; PDF names are human labels. Any field correspondence must come from the semantic maps, which are per form and are not yet extended to the current PDFs.
